Leg check
Each leg's predicted chance next to how often it hit.
When "Predicted" runs well above "Hit", the model is overconfident. "Book" is the chance the sportsbook's price implies (vig removed). The model-vs-book score compares how close each came to what happened, leg by leg (lower error wins).

Touchdown picks
The board's top 10 for the whole week by chance to score. Didn't play = no action.

Every pick
Tap a pick to see its legs and the actual stats.
Pick a week in the menu at the top to see every pick and its legs.

Each pick is the generator's Best pick for that window, leg count and target, made before the games from the board's prices, and graded with today's generator rules. Hit rates count settled picks only (every leg final); pending ones aren't counted. Money is $10 on each pick at FanDuel's posted price. Break-even is the hit rate those prices needed to make money. Live marks a leg from a game already under way when the board was built.

Bets · odds in, payout out

Type each bet's odds (e.g. -150 or +120) and its payout fills in. Blank = planned odds, shown with ~. Mark ✓ or ✕ when it settles, or tap the rung on the graphic.

This rung's bet · as a picture

The parlay you're placing for the next rung, with the model's hit rate, the historical hit rate and the flags — ready to post.

Or press and hold the picture and pick "Save to Photos".

Save image saves the ladder graphic in Instagram's 4:5 shape (1080 × 1350). "Start a new ladder" clears the results and the odds.

Set up

Planned odds fill in any bet you haven't priced yet. With a number of bets set, the ladder always has that many rungs and the last one shows what it actually pays; leave it blank to add bets until the goal is reached. Put each bet's real odds in the list above as you place it.

Saved on this phone, and in this page's address. Safari can clear a site's saved data after 7 days away — keep a backup with Copy ladder link (open it later to bring the ladder back), or add this page to your Home Screen and open it from there.

Sync across devices

Off — this ladder lives only on this device.

Keeps the ladders, the progression calculator and your Instagram settings the same on your phone and laptop, through a private file in your own GitHub account (a secret Gist).

1. Make a GitHub token — only the gist box ticked (it can't touch anything else). Pick an expiration, tap Generate, copy it.
2. Paste it here, on each device, and tap Connect. The newest copy wins.

Progression calculator

All-in compounding toward a target, banking part of the winnings at checkpoints. Each bet's odds can be different — type the real price in its row. Mark each bet won or lost to track where you are.

BetOddsRiskingIf winBankedCarryNet worthCPResult

Blank odds use the default. CP = checkpoint: tick or untick any bet (it then stops spacing them for you). The table assumes every bet still to play wins; one loss zeroes what's riding on it — checkpoints protect only cash already banked. Saved on this phone.
